tool_note: The sandbox used by this session could only reach the network through the page-fetch tool; command-line fetches to amazon.com and link.amazon were refused at the connection layer. Every observation below is therefore a tool-fetch result, and each one names the URL that was fetched so it can be repeated by hand.
